Backend: All CRUD operations for breakout sessions work correctly (start, get, close, move, auto-assign). 5 minor failures are auth error code issues (returns 500 instead of 401/403 for unauthenticated requests - the get_current_user dependency returns None and causes TypeError when accessing user['user_id']). Frontend BreakoutRoomManager component verified via code review - all required data-testids present. To access BreakoutRoomManager UI: login as host → create/join meeting → click Participants button → click 'Breakout Rooms' button. Component renders in side panel with room cards, unassigned pool, timer toggle with presets (3m,5m,10m,15m,20m), AI Auto-Assign button, and Open/Close Rooms buttons.

breakout_session_management.start: Creates session with rooms array, timer_minutes, auto_assign option
breakout_session_management.close: Closes all rooms, clears participant assignments, returns count
breakout_session_management.move: Moves participant between rooms, enforces max 10 capacity
breakout_session_management.auto_assign: Round-robin distribution, excludes host, respects num_rooms param

ui_components.ai_button: Sparkles icon, calls auto-assign preview endpoint

websocket_messages.breakout_session_started: Broadcasts to all when host starts session
